recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a shirtless, heavily tattooed man with braided hair, posing with hands near his temples against a blurred, textured background of dried organic material. The lighting is warm and directional, emphasizing muscle definition and ink detail.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's tattoos act as a secondary layer of visual storytelling over the skin.
The warm, golden-brown background texture complements the subject's skin tone.
The aggressive, distressed typography in the upper right balances the subject's central weight.
Symmetry is created by the hand placement framing the face.
coreInvariants: Visible, intricate tattoo work across the chest and arms
A shallow depth of field blurring the background into vertical textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium shot from waist up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and intense gaze, framed by the hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down to the chest tattoos, then up to the top-right typography, and finally to the bottom-right advisory label.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with blurred vertical lines of dried grass or reeds.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and tan tones (background and skin mid-tones).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns (tattoos, hair, and shadows).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red (subtitle text) and bright silver (watch).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with desaturated, earthy color palette.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text features heavy distressing, erosion, and dry-brush textures.
Secondary text uses a clean, condensed, all-caps sans-serif.
Letters in the primary title have varying baselines for a rhythmic, aggressive feel.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Jagged edges on the 'C' and 'H' to mimic blade-like or torn paper effects.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive textured display paired with clean, geometric condensed sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory box in bottom right
Subtle vignette to focus on the subject

preserve: Distressed texture of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the eroded, aggressive brush-stroke aesthetic of the main title.
Provides the clean, condensed structure for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a shirtless man with intricate chest and arm tattoos and braided hair. He is posing with fingers to his temples. The background is a blurred texture of vertical dried reeds in warm golden-brown tones. Lighting should be dramatic and warm.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, black, distressed brush-style title in the top right. Below it, add a subtitle in a clean, condensed red sans-serif font with wide tracking. Place a standard parental advisory label in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main title visibly eroded/distressed?
Is the subtitle red and condensed?
Is the subject's skin tone warm and the tattoos sharp?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to create depth?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the main title
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact tattoo designs (use generic urban/religious motifs)
Specific brand logos on the watch

mustAchieve: Balanced typographic weight in the upper right

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the red subtitle is legible against the background.
Verify the tattoos look like they are on the skin, not floating.
Confirm the background texture remains vertical and organic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Distressed Display Typography + Warm Earth Tones + Shallow Depth of Field
